input.summary: All 25 unsettled controls for Hollow Knight: Silksong have been addressed. 12 were bound directly from a clear dominant habit (evidenced): kb_z, kb_c, kb_a, X, B, Y, left_bumper, left_trigger, back, start, left_joy_up, left_joy_down. 1 was bound from a small but consistent sample (inferred): kb_j. 12 were referred to the user as questions because their history was too split to decide safely, or because the control has no known function in this game and needs a human call on whether to leave it unbound or duplicate a habitual mouth movement: kb_s, kb_f, kb_i, kb_q, right_trigger, right_bumper, dpad_N, dpad_S, kb_e, kb_left_control, kb_left_shift, mouse_right_button.
